name: How long does it typically take to install easy access drawers?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install easy access drawers?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for easy access drawers varies depending on the number of drawers, cabinet type, and any necessary modifications. For a standard kitchen with 5-10 drawers, installation can typically be completed within one to two days. More extensive projects involving multiple rooms or custom alterations might extend to several days. We strive to work efficiently to minimize disruption, and our team will provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for easy access drawers typically ranges from one to two days for a standard kitchen, depending on project scope.
